title: GRAPH TABLE was disabled in v14 before its formal 17 R5 removal
disposition: Confirmed catalog correction, not a 4D product defect. Preserve the stable ID and formal 17 R5 removal evidence, but use the explicitly documented v14 disabling as the earliest actionable behavior restriction. All five summaries distinguish disabled from removed. Upgrades starting at v16 or later must not treat this as a newly crossed runtime requirement. The reasoned final override and regression assertions implement the correction; resolved does not mean human-reviewed. The tracking issue closes with the scoped content PR.
